# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Deceased
- **Origin:** Innsmouth, Massachusetts
- **Role:** Sea Captain
- **Titles:** Captain Obed Abernethy

## Appearance

Obed Abernethy was a rugged sea captain who later in life began to show the physical signs of the 'Innsmouth look'. He possessed wide, unblinking eyes, a flattened nose, and thick, folded skin along his neck. Over time, his gait became an unnatural, shuffling hop.

## Personality

Obed was an ambitious, pragmatic, and ruthless man driven by a desire for wealth and community prosperity at any cost. He possessed a domineering presence and showed little regard for traditional morality or religious orthodoxy when profit and power were at stake. His devotion to the deep-sea entities was calculated yet absolute.

## Traits

- Ambitious
- Pragmatic
- Ruthless
- Resourceful

## Abilities

- Seamanship and navigation
- Leadership and persuasion
- Summoning and bargaining with Deep Ones

## Goals

- Restore prosperity and wealth to Innsmouth through gold and abundant fishing yields
- Secure immortality and communion with the Deep Ones for himself and his lineage

## History

Captain Obed Abernethy sailed his merchant vessels throughout the South Pacific in the early nineteenth century, where he encountered islanders who traded strange gold and never suffered from famine. After learning their secrets and obtaining rituals to communicate with the Deep Ones, Obed returned to Innsmouth, which was suffering from severe economic hardship. He established contact with the undersea creatures off Devil Reef, trading human sacrifices and loyalty for vast quantities of fish and mysterious gold. Obed founded the Esoteric Order of Dagon to enforce this new worship among the townspeople and secure intermarriage between humans and the Deep Ones. Despite facing resistance and brief imprisonment from local authorities in 1846, the strange entities retaliated on his behalf, securing his freedom and cementing his absolute control over the town. Obed spent his final years undergoing the transformation into an amphibious creature before disappearing into the sea.

## Background by volume

- Traded in the South Pacific where he learned of strange marine worship from Polynesian natives
- Brought strange gold ornaments back to Innsmouth during an economic decline
- Established the Esoteric Order of Dagon to formalize pacts with immortal ocean creatures

## Affiliations

- Esoteric Order of Dagon — Founder and High Priest
- Town of Innsmouth — Prominent leader and benefactor

## Relationships

### The Deep Ones

- Comrade of — Formed a pact with them for gold, fish, and immortality
